avd-swarm

Personal project. Research and learning only. Not for production. No warranty.
  • Built on my own time for research and learning. Not affiliated with, endorsed by or supported by my employer, Liquidware or Microsoft.
  • Don't run any of it in production or against tenants that matter. Test in a dedicated lab subscription and tenant first.
  • Provided "as is", without warranty of any kind, under each repo's license. You use it at your own risk and own the Azure charges it incurs.
  • Contributions and forks are welcome and encouraged. See Contribute.

Act and control. Agents that manage Azure and Entra ID without the portals. They read freely and change nothing until a person approves the exact plan.

The repo is the source of truth: nickprignano/avd-swarm. This page says where it fits.

What it does

  • A coordinator hands questions to specialist agents: readiness, deploy, hosts, images, users and cost.
  • Writes go through plans approved in GitHub Environments, with one layered kill switch only the owner resets.
  • The write path never runs in the public repo; adopters run it from a private repo synced from a release tag.
  • Today only the S1a spike runs. Everything after the first two write actions is designed, not scheduled.

How it fits

  • Gets estate facts only from avd-second-brain, as cited C11 and C12 evidence, and re-reads live state before any change.
  • Changes together with avd-second-brain (decision 0003).
